preconditions.description: The number of names is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name_i) <= 100 for name_i in names)
preconditions.description: Each name has a length between 1 and 100.
All characters in the names are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Impossible' or a permutation of 26 lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Impossible' or all(return_value[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for i in range(26))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', it contains exactly 26 unique lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Impossible' or all(return_value.index(names[i][j]) <= return_value.index(names[i+1][j]) for i in range(n-1) for j in range(min(len(names[i]), len(names[i+1]))))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', the names are sorted lexicographically according to the new alphabet order.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Impossible' or all(return_value.index(names[i][j]) < return_value.index(names[i+1][j]) for i in range(n-1) for j in range(min(len(names[i]), len(names[i+1]))) if j == min(len(names[i]), len(names[i+1])) - 1 or names[i][j+1] != names[i+1][j+1])
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', the names are strictly sorted lexicographically according to the new alphabet order.
